geometric_argument.Q1_Q2_coprime: Any common linear factor reduces modW to B, hence B+kW; it divides D, contradicting nonzero D mod(B,W). A quadratic common factor would imply proportionality.
geometric_argument.minor_ideal_height2: Contains coprime Q1,Q2, while the maximal-minor height bound is2; Hilbert-Burch gives CM pure projective curve.
geometric_argument.set_decomposition: V(Q1,Q2)=V(B,W) union V(all3 minors), from WD=40XQ1-AQ2 and the W=0 alternatives.
geometric_argument.vertex_avoided: The exact binary resultant is nonzero on D(R_vertex).
geometric_argument.P3_piece: Closed subset disjoint from vertex P1 has dimension<=1 by the projective dimension theorem.
geometric_argument.cone_piece: Projection from vertex on closed projective Y is proper; every closed fiber in a ruling P2 avoids its line P1 and therefore has dimension<=0.
geometric_argument.no_smoothness_or_reducedness: Purity and support dimensions suffice; curve may be reducible or nonreduced.
geometric_argument.height4: Both pieces have projective dimension<=1, so four quadrics in six variables have height4 and form a regular sequence.
